text: The company register lists VALEANSE (SIREN 798816682, SAS, 490 rue Augustin Jacq, Brest) under the trading name GROUPE SOFT, with Fabrice Paul Lucien Boudinet as its Président de SAS. The club's partner page for Soft (Société d'Organisation Financière et Technique, which designs and builds commercial and industrial buildings) gives 490 rue Docteur Augustin Jacq, Brest, and names Boudinet Fabrice as contact.
short: Groupe SOFT is the trading name of VALEANSE, whose Président is Fabrice Boudinet.
